subject: Medford Liquor Licensing Regulations
overview: Host John Petrella interviewed Licensing Commission Chair Robert Delafano regarding the city's liquor licensing procedures, available license quotas, application costs, and regulatory compliance.

items.title: Introduction and Guest Background
items.summary: Robert Delafano discussed his background as a lifelong Medford resident, former firefighter, business owner, and wholesale liquor salesman.

items.title: Licensing Commission Operations and Membership
items.summary: Delafano outlined the commission's public meeting schedule and introduced commissioners Alan Maturana and Ben O'Sullivan Pierce and secretary Daria Tahara.

items.title: License Categories and Quotas
items.summary: Delafano explained the state license classifications and reported that Medford has 28 on-premise pouring licenses available, while off-premise package store licenses remain capped at the statutory limit of 12.

items.title: Application Procedures and Municipal Fees
items.summary: Delafano detailed the joint application process with the state Alcoholic Beverages Control Commission (ABCC) and reviewed annual licensing and entertainment permit fees.

items.title: Enforcement, Compliance Checks, and Renewals
items.summary: Delafano reviewed common violations, undercover compliance checks conducted with local police, annual educational meetings, and the mandatory November 30 renewal deadline.

items.title: License Transfers and Secondary Market Sales
items.summary: Delafano explained how license transfers operate during business sales and noted that licenses carry financial value only when municipal quotas are exhausted.

items.title: Closing Announcements
items.summary: Petrella concluded the broadcast with station information and details on how residents can contact the show.
